findings.claim: C-COR-MAJ-001 (validate step id missing, upload/attest gated only on build outcome) is confirmed closed against actual repo state at HEAD dd88b2e.
findings.evidence: policy-check.yml line 1450: 'id: validate-scorecard-emit' is present on the 'Validate scorecard emit against schema' step. Line 1474: 'Upload scorecard emit artifact' if-condition is 'inputs.scorecard-emit && steps.validate-scorecard-emit.outcome == 'success'' — correctly gates on the validate step, not only the build step. The Attest step moved to a separate 'attest-scorecard' job (lines 1586-1612) with 'needs: policy-check' and 'if: inputs.scorecard-emit'. Under GitHub Actions job-level semantics, 'needs: policy-check' requires policy-check to reach a success state (all non-always() steps completed) before attest-scorecard runs; a validate-scorecard-emit failure causes policy-check to fail, which skips attest-scorecard. Even under the alternative interpretation where an explicit 'if:' replaces the implicit success() gate, the artifact was not uploaded (upload gated on validate-scorecard-emit.outcome == 'success'), so actions/download-artifact would fail hard, preventing attestation of an invalid emit in both interpretations.

findings.evidence: policy-check.yml lines 1304-1309: waived_rule_ids pre-computed as a set comprehension over waivers_applied, with isinstance+non-empty guards. Line 1322: 'if verdict == "deny" and rid not in waived_rule_ids: entry["denies"] += 1' — effective deny count, suppressed findings excluded. tests/scorecard-emit/fixtures/deny-with-waiver/expected-scorecard-emit.json: SCP-R-001.denies=0, waived=1, verdict='allow'. tests/scorecard-emit/fixtures/full/expected-scorecard-emit.json: SCP-R-001.denies=0 (waived), SCP-R-002.denies=1 (no waiver), verdict='deny'. Traced against full/policy-check-summary.json: waivers_applied=[{rule_id:SCP-R-001}] → waived_rule_ids={'SCP-R-001'}; SCP-R-001 finding verdict=deny blocked by waived_rule_ids check → denies=0; SCP-R-002 finding verdict=deny not in waived_rule_ids → denies=1. Aggregate verdict: any(denies>0) True via SCP-R-002 → 'deny'. All values consistent.

findings.claim: The scorecard emitter's 'warn' aggregate verdict branch is unreachable for the designated warn-baseline rule (SCP-R-004). A run where only SCP-R-004 fires without a waiver will produce scorecard verdict='deny' even though the gate passed, violating plan-doc invariant 1 (faithful reporting). This is a pre-existing gap not introduced by fix-round-1 but not surfaced by R1.
findings.evidence: policy-check.yml 'Render deny annotations and enforce threshold' step: WARN_BASELINE_RULES = {'SCP-R-004'}; warn_baseline_findings are selected from the denies list ('denies = [item for item in payload if item.get("verdict") == "deny"]') — confirming SCP-R-004 findings carry verdict='deny' in policy-check-summary.findings. Scorecard emitter Build heredoc line 1322: 'if verdict == "deny" and rid not in waived_rule_ids: entry["denies"] += 1' — no WARN_BASELINE_RULES exclusion is present in the scorecard emitter. For an unwaived SCP-R-004 finding: rid='SCP-R-004' not in waived_rule_ids (no waiver) AND verdict='deny' → denies += 1 → SCP-R-004.denies=1. Aggregate verdict lines 1349-1354: 'if any(v["denies"] > 0 for v in rule_counts.values()): verdict = "deny"' fires before the warn branch. The warn branch at line 1351 requires 'v["denies"] == 0', which is not satisfied for an unwaived SCP-R-004 finding. schemas/scorecard-emit.schema.json line 53 verdict description: 'warn if only warn-baseline rules fired' — this contract is unimplemented. The inline comment in the emitter at line 1352 explicitly says '# raw findings unsuppressed: treat as warn (warn-baseline rule fired)' — confirming the intent was to reach this branch for warn-baseline scenarios. No test fixture exercises a warn-baseline-only run (SCP-R-004 without waiver); the existing test matrix covers minimal/full/deny-with-waiver but not warn-only.
findings.impact: A PR run where only SCP-R-004 fires (warn-baseline rule, gate passes — effective_denies=0, PR is allowed through) produces scorecard verdict='deny'. The 023C aggregator will misreport this adopter as having a denied policy state when the gate actually passed. This directly violates plan-doc §2 invariant 1: 'the aggregator MUST faithfully report verified emit content — a divergence between the aggregator's reported state and an adopter's actual policy-check-summary.json is a verification failure, not a smoothing artefact.' The schema's 'warn' verdict enum value is effectively dead code in the current implementation — no code path can produce it for any currently deployed SCP rule. The gap is pre-existing (present before fix-round-1) and was not caught by R1.
findings.mitigation: Inline fix: add WARN_BASELINE_RULES exclusion to the denies counter in the scorecard emitter heredoc, mirroring the 'Render deny annotations' step. In the Build scorecard emit Python heredoc, define 'WARN_BASELINE_RULES = {"SCP-R-004"}' near the top (after the summary/waivers/disabled_rules loads), then change line 1322 from 'if verdict == "deny" and rid not in waived_rule_ids:' to 'if verdict == "deny" and rid not in waived_rule_ids and rid not in WARN_BASELINE_RULES:'. Add a fourth test fixture (warn-baseline) with a SCP-R-004 finding and no matching waiver, expecting verdict='warn'. Note the coupling: when a second warn-baseline rule lands, WARN_BASELINE_RULES in the emitter must be updated alongside the threshold step — TF-020P-001 in the existing code already flags this as a promotion candidate for a data-driven manifest; that same path applies here. File as fix-round-2 blocker (pre-existing MAJ, not from fix-round-1 deltas, but blocking R2 APPROVED status per governance invariants).

self_reported_concerns: R2-COR-CLOS-001 (attest-scorecard job gating): The gating analysis assumes GitHub Actions job-level 'needs:' semantics require the needed job to succeed even when the dependent job has an explicit 'if:' condition that does not reference success()/failure(). GitHub documentation has some ambiguity around whether a job-level explicit 'if:' replaces or ANDs with the implicit needs-success check. I analyzed both interpretations: under either, the critical invariant holds — an invalid scorecard-emit cannot be attested. If 'if: inputs.scorecard-emit' replaces the success() check, attest-scorecard would attempt to run even when policy-check failed, but actions/download-artifact would hard-fail (artifact not uploaded since upload was gated on validate-scorecard-emit.outcome == 'success'), causing attest-scorecard to fail before attestation. The safer explicit form 'if: inputs.scorecard-emit && needs.policy-check.result == ''success''' would be clearer but is not a blocking correctness issue under either interpretation of the current code.

R2-COR-MAJ-001 severity: I am classifying this as MAJ because the schema's 'warn' verdict is documented as reachable ('warn if only warn-baseline rules fired') and the implementation violates that contract plus plan-doc invariant 1. However, in practice a warn-baseline-only run is unlikely during v0.x when most adopters will have mixed findings (both deny and warn-baseline). The gap is only observable in edge-case runs. An alternative classification is MIN (aspirational schema contract not yet fully implemented). I retain MAJ because (a) SCP-R-004 is deployed and fires on real repos with outdated deps; (b) the schema description creates a binding contract that 023C's aggregator will rely on; (c) there is no fixture testing this path, making the gap invisible in CI.
